The test image shows a soybean leaf with brown/reddish-brown irregular lesions in the central area, with some yellowish discoloration around them. The lesions appear coalescing and are on the upper leaf surface.

Key features: irregular brown lesions, some yellowing around them, on the upper leaf surface of what appears to be a lower canopy leaf.

Top candidates: Septoria_brown_spot, Bacterial_Blight, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus

Let me view reference images one at a time.
Septoria brown spot shows many small dark dots on yellowing leaves — doesn't match the test image well. The test has fewer, larger irregular brown patches.
This Bacterial Blight reference is a strong match — irregular dark brown lesions with yellowish-green halos on green leaves, very similar to the test image.
Frogeye leaf spot shows small circular spots — doesn't match the larger irregular patches in the test image.
Vein necrosis virus shows more yellow/orange spots, partially similar but the test image has darker brown lesions.
Second Bacterial Blight reference confirms — dark brown lesions with yellow halos on green leaves. Strong match. Let me continue checking other candidates.
Downy mildew shows small light green/yellow spots — doesn't match.
Cercospora shows many small scattered purple/reddish spots — doesn't match.
Phyllosticta shows tan/brown lesions with dark borders — similar pattern but more circular.
Bacterial Pustule shows many small scattered spots — doesn't match the test image well.
Soybean rust shows many tiny scattered spots — doesn't match.
SDS shows interveinal necrosis — doesn't match.
Brown stem rot shows severe interveinal necrosis — doesn't match.
Powdery mildew shows white powdery patches — clearly doesn't match.

Anthracnose shows curling and small spots with reddened petiole — doesn't match.

I need 1 more view. Let me check the third Bacterial Blight reference to confirm.

I've now used all 16 views. 

**Summary of comparisons:**
- **Bacterial_Blight** (Dise_17, Dise_56): Best match — irregular dark brown lesions with yellowish-green halos on a green leaf, closely resembling the test image
- Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus: More yellow/orange spots, less similar
- Septoria_brown_spot: Many tiny scattered dark dots, doesn't match
- Bacterial_Pustule: Many small scattered spots, doesn't match
- Cercospora, Soybean_rust: Numerous tiny scattered spots, doesn't match
- Frogeye_leaf_spot: Small circular spots with holes, doesn't match
- Brown_Stem_Rot, SDS: Interveinal necrosis pattern, doesn't match
- Downy_mildew, Powdery_Mildew, Anthracnose: Clearly different

The test image shows 1-2 irregular, coalescing brown lesions with yellowish halos on an otherwise green leaf — a characteristic Bacterial Blight presentation, confirmed by two reference images.
